mentions.heading: Natural disasters and climate change may negatively impact our business
mentions.detail: Factories in earthquake, flood or storm zones in Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand; 2011 Japan tsunami hit supply chains
mentions.quote: The impact of any such natural disasters depends on the specific geographic circumstances but could be significant, as some of our factories are located in areas with known earthquake fault zones, flood or storm risks, including but not limited to Singapore, Taiwan, Malaysia or Thailand.

mentions.heading: Climate change may cause more natural disasters affecting operations
mentions.detail: February 2021 winter storm disrupted Austin, Texas fabs and their water and utilities
mentions.quote: Such natural disasters pose physical risks to our manufacturing, IT facilities or our suppliers’ facilities, or could disrupt the availability of water and utilities necessary for the operation of our manufacturing facilities or our suppliers’ facilities resulting in increased operating costs and business disruption, such as the disruption to our Austin, Texas manufacturing facilities caused by the February 2021 winter storm and weather-related disruption of water and utilities to these facilities.

mentions.heading: Water scarcity in semi-arid manufacturing regions
mentions.detail: Water-intensive semiconductor manufacturing; many own and supplier sites in semi-arid regions vulnerable to drought
mentions.quote: In addition, semiconductor manufacturing is a water-intensive process. Many of our manufacturing sites and those of our suppliers are located in semi–arid regions that may become increasingly vulnerable to prolonged droughts associated with evolving changes to the climate, which may lead to water scarcity.

mentions.heading: Acquisitions and strategic transactions could adversely affect results
mentions.detail: Routine acquisitions, joint ventures, minority equity stakes and loans; integration of employees, R&D, systems challenging
mentions.quote: If we do not achieve the anticipated benefits of business acquisitions or other strategic activities, or if we are unable to consummate acquisitions or strategic investments that we consider important to the future of our business, our business and results of operations may be adversely affected and our growth strategy may not be successful.

mentions.heading: Government approval required for acquisitions
mentions.detail: Agencies have previously denied or delayed approval of transactions
mentions.quote: Certain agencies in the past have, and may in the future, deny the transaction or fail to approve in a timely manner, resulting in delays in closing and us not realizing the anticipated benefits of the proposed transactions.
